description: Electron-builder portable Windows packaging looks for the generated icon under the expanded version folder while the temporary icon was written under the literal `${version}` folder, based on https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/issues/7711.
prompt:
I want every Windows build to land under `release/<version>`, but the portable build is failing while loading the icon. The same icon builds on macOS, so I don't think the image itself is corrupt.

```
Error while loading icon from "E:\gardenbox\release\0.0.0\.icon-ico\icon.ico": can't open file
```
